exposure: Demand side financing maternal and child health voucher scheme (DSF-MCHVS)
outcome: Service utilization (skilled birth attendant, delivery at health facilities, postnatal care, vaccination)
cohort: Pregnant women in Yedashae Township, Myanmar.
finding: The DSF-MCHVS program significantly increased care with a skilled birth attendant, but did not significantly increase delivery at health facilities and may have slightly decreased postnatal care utilization; there was no significant increase in vaccination, while normal deliveries decreased and caesarian sections increased.
